qa_pairs.question: An order is already Packing and carrier interception fails. What must the customer do next, and what return rule applies to an opened standard device?

qa_pairs.question: After the return window, how is a covered defect handled and how long can diagnosis and repair take?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: After the return window, a covered defect follows the repair process. Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product, and a covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available.

contexts.text: The warranty is separate from the return policy. Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.

Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.
